# The game functions built at -O2 with inline main-RAM access on the 3DS
# (split_gen.py --hot; port/3ds/CMakeLists.txt). Every recompiled function

# gsample (a stack sampler, 1 kHz) watched the PC build replay a walk from
# the title into town, 2026-10-25: 33 s of town plus the whole 68 s run.
# One PSP address per line.
